theme: 3 SwiftUI controls for picking a number, a date and a color

terms.definition: A control with minus and plus buttons that changes a number up or down.

video.title: Stepper, DatePicker & ColorPicker | Day 171
video.description:
Learn to explain how to ask users for numbers, dates and colors in SwiftUI: Stepper, DatePicker & ColorPicker, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Stepper - A control with minus and plus buttons that changes a number up or down.
DatePicker - A control that lets people choose a date, a time or both.
ColorPicker - A control that opens a color panel so people can choose a color.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain Stepper, DatePicker & ColorPicker in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
스테퍼, 데이트피커, 컬러피커 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Stepper - A control with minus and plus buttons that changes a number up or down.
한국어: 스테퍼: 빼기와 더하기 버튼으로 숫자를 올리고 내리는 컨트롤

DatePicker - A control that lets people choose a date, a time or both.
한국어: 데이트피커: 날짜, 시간 또는 둘 다를 고르게 하는 컨트롤

ColorPicker - A control that opens a color panel so people can choose a color.
한국어: 컬러피커: 색상 패널을 열어 색을 고르게 하는 컨트롤

landscape.hook: Can you explain Stepper, DatePicker and ColorPicker in English?

dialogue.title: A booking form

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I am building a booking form with a number, a date and a color.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Start with a Stepper for the number of tickets.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does the Stepper show the number by itself?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, it only has minus and plus, so show `n` in the label.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: For the trip day, I made a text field. Users type the date.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That can go wrong. Use a DatePicker, and you get a real `Date` in `day`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Oh, that is safer. Can the DatePicker show only the time?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, you can choose the date, the time or both.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Last, the user wants a theme color.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add a ColorPicker. It opens a color panel and saves the choice in `tint`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So a Stepper, a DatePicker and a ColorPicker, and no typing mistakes.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. Keep all three values as `@State`.
Use a Stepper for the ticket count.
